text.en: Clients consistently praise Eric and his team for their high standard of reliability and dependable service. Pet parents express immense peace of mind when travelling, knowing their homes and companion animals are in trustworthy hands. Reviewers also appreciate the team's flexibility when accommodating short-notice requests or unexpected travel changes.

Reviews highlight thorough and loving care for dogs and cats alike, particularly older pets and those that become anxious in standard boarding kennels. Owners recount how sitters follow detailed feeding routines, let dogs out multiple times daily, clean food dishes, and provide genuine companionship, leaving animals calm and contented in their own homes.

Customer feedback strongly highlights the quality of communication provided throughout each sitting assignment. Pet owners praise the convenient online client portal and messaging system, which delivers daily alerts and informative photos of pets. Reviewers state that receiving these detailed updates allows them to enjoy business trips and holidays without worry.

q.en: Does Metro Pup SA provide care for cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, client reviews confirm that sitters provide dedicated home visits, feeding, and companionship for both cats and dogs.

q.en: What kind of updates do owners receive while away?

a.en: Pet sitters send daily messages, alerts, and photo updates through their online client portal to keep owners informed.

q.en: Can the team accommodate short-notice or emergency bookings?

a.en: Reviewers note that the team is accommodating and responsive when arranging last-minute schedule adjustments or unplanned trips.
